name: i.safe MOBILE IS440.2
summary: The i.safe MOBILE IS440.2 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) 5G push-to-talk radio from i.safe MOBILE, certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX and IECEx, and for Class I Division 2 in North America. It runs ISM-OS 14, with 5G and a user-replaceable battery.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex ic IIIC T135°C Dc
atex.scope: voluntary Certificate of Conformity, Bureau Veritas

iecex.marking: Ex ic IIC T4 Gc / Ex ic IIIC T135°C Dc

certification.northAmerica: Class I, Division 2, Groups ABCD, T4; Class II, Division 2, Groups FG, 135°C; Class III (QPS Certificate of Compliance LR3081-8R1, 30 Sep 2025; CSA C22.2 No. 213, UL 121201)

safety.charging: Allowed in gas Zone 2 and Class I Division 2, through the external charging contacts
safety.conditions: EPS 23 ATEX 1 250 X / IECEx EPS 23.0070X: protect from high-energy impacts, excessive UV light and high electrostatic charge processes; USB-C cover must be securely closed in hazardous areas (USB-C charging/data outside hazardous areas only); Ta −20 °C to +55 °C; battery may be replaced outside hazardous areas only; may be charged inside gas hazardous areas (EPL Gc) only via the external charging contacts with i.safe-approved charging equipment, with all gaskets present and functional, at 0 °C to +45 °C, with regular checks, and charging voltage ensuring Um = 5.88 V, Ii = 3.4 A; in dust areas (EPL Dc) charge outside hazardous areas only; nano-SIM cards meeting Uo 5.88 V, Co 40 µF, Lo 1 µH. QPS LR3081-8R1: contact charging allowed in Class I Div 2, not in Class II Div 2.

specs.gnss: GPS, A-GPS, GLONASS, A-GLONASS, BeiDou, Galileo (web page also lists NavIC, QZSS, SBAS)
specs.keys: Dedicated PTT; programmable red key (SOS/LWP); channel selector; M1/M2 keys
specs.accessories: 8-pin ISM interface (audio accessories); USB-C; charging contacts
specs.apps: App World (curated PTT and MDM apps)

capabilities.label: Push-to-talk
capabilities.value: Built in (dedicated PTT key + PoC apps)

variants.name: EdgeTwo
variants.description: The IS440.2 is also certified under the name EdgeTwo, with the same certificates.

unconfirmed.specs.dimensionsMm: From i.safe MOBILE's datasheet; its web page gives a width of 70 mm.

strengths: May be charged inside gas Zone 2 through its charging contacts
ATEX and IECEx certified, with published certificate numbers
Also certified for Class I Division 2 in North America
limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
